deep.reconstruction: There is no original mathematical content on folio 32v. Apart from paper damage (a water/glue stain at the top, tears and repair strips along the right edge), the only marks are about six very faint lines of formulas in the upper-middle of the sheet. These are almost certainly show-through of the ink on the recto (folio 32r, the 'November 1859' page transcribed as the previous page). Three observations support this. (i) The faint marks have the same layout and density as the recto's formula lines. (ii) Recognisable shapes match the recto: a fraction-like group near the top consistent with Π(s/2−1); 'dlog'-type derivative quotients in the middle lines; and a long final line containing a large bracket group and fractional exponents, consistent with the recto's last line, π^{-s/2} ζ(s) Π(s/2−1) = ∫_{−∞}^{∞} k²k'² (…)(KK'/π²)^{9/4}(1 − (3/2)(∂log K/∂log k')(∂log K'/∂log k))(K'/K)^{s/2−1/4} ∂log(K'/K) · π²/(4s(s−1)). (iii) The ink is much fainter than direct writing, and the rest of the sheet is blank. The bleed-through is too faint to decide from the image whether it reads mirror-reversed. Any content therefore belongs to 32r. That content is Riemann's rewriting of the theta-function Mellin representation of ξ(s) in terms of the complete elliptic integrals K, K' (with q = e^{−πK'/K} and θ_3(q)² = 2K/π), aimed at a representation symmetric under K ↔ K', i.e. s ↔ 1−s. Nothing new is derived on this verso, so there is nothing to reconstruct beyond identifying the show-through.

results.what: No independent result on this page; faint traces are show-through of the recto's elliptic-function (K, K') form of the Mellin integral for π^{-s/2}Γ(s/2)ζ(s).
results.modern_name: Theta-function / Jacobi-modular representation of the completed zeta function (Riemann 1859 second proof of the functional equation), here expressed via complete elliptic integrals
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (1859) for the theta-function proof; Jacobi for θ_3² = 2K/π

deep.surprise_reason: The page is effectively blank; the only visible marks are bleed-through of folio 32r, whose content is already accounted for on that page.

checkable.asserts: Mellin integral underlying the recto (show-through) content: ∫_0^∞ e^{-π n² x} x^{s/2-1} dx = Γ(s/2) π^{-s/2} n^{-s} (should simplify to 0 for n>0, Re s>0).
Jacobi relation θ_3(q)² = 2K/π used on the recto: at k² = 1/2 (K = K', q = e^{-π}), K should equal (π/2)·θ_3(e^{-π})² (≈1.8541). Here sympy's elliptic_k takes the parameter m = k².

Apart from this show-through and paper damage/repair strips at the top and right edge, the page is blank.
